choice.basis: On the Units Sold by Product (Weekend Pop-up) chart, the vertical axis is linear with evenly spaced ticks at 10,000, 20,000, etc. The Product A bar top is below the 10,000 tick, at roughly 80% of the distance from the baseline to the 10,000 tick, giving an estimated value of about 8,000 units. This falls within the policy condition '>= 4,000 and < 9,000 units', which maps to the low-demand review route.
